317-1475-3899.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional modified creature with power 1 or greater.
317-1475-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another modified creature with power one or greater.
When the creature dies, Mazirek and One with the Kami triggers.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Mazirek trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

2292-5254-5902.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2292-5254-5902.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

1753-2105-5778-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

3197-3967-6854--196.description:

Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 5.

Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

11-5195-7089.easyPrerequisites:
You have another instant or sorcery in hand that can be cast using at most four colored mana, with valid targets (as applicable).
You have enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery minus {R}{R}.
11-5195-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Cast the additional instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Fire Lord Azula trigger, copying the instant or sorcery.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers. Resolve both triggers from this step and step 3, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the spell from step 2.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Fire Lord Azula trigger, copying Narset's Reversal targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original spell from step 2, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the spell from step 2 and returning the original spell from step 2 to your hand.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of the spell from step 14.
Holding priority, repeat from step 2.

1624-5957-7439.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast a copy of Channel from exile by paying {G}{G}, unpreparing Yavimaya Bloomsage.
Activate Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

2438-7084-7422.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

240-5256-5470-7060.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

141-944-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Planar Gate.

Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat from step 3.

465-4605-6798-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2281-6909.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2034-2281-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. 
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Carnage.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Carnage.
When Carnage dies, Saffi triggers, returning Carnage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ashnod's Altar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

250-779-1479-3534-5413.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-3534-5413.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
250-779-1479-3534-5413.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1479-2783-2841-6156.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2783-2841-6156.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Nesting Dragon and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1084-3108-3908.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Spark Double.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Spark Double by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life

Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.

Repeat each combat phase.

When Infernal Vessel dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel in additional to its other types.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2457-2557-4289-4359.description:

Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.

997-1429-5402-5929.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.

When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1636-3143-4642-6170.easyPrerequisites:

There is a counter on a permanent you control.

Resolve the Khalni Heart Expedition trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

5904-6078.notablePrerequisites:

Holding priority, activate mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Adric's first ability by paying {2}{U} and tapping them, copying the Fifth Doctor's trigger.
Resolve the copied triggered ability, untapping all creatures you control that didn't enter or attack this turn and putting a +1/+1 counter on each them.
Repeat from 2.

Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Havi.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Havi, adding {C}{C}.

Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Nahiri's Resolve triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

When Melira's Keepers dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Melira's Keepers from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Melira's Keepers' ability.
Repeat.

Repeat.

When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener.
